title: Straw mineralization and carbon dioxide emissions in soils with different salinity levels
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00698D, Paper
Cailing Shi, Jing Zhang, Haibo Zhang, Lei Xu, Wenjun Xie, Weiming Li, Lichang Zhang, Yu Sun
Soil salinization inhibited straw mineralization and induced a priming effect. The peak straw mineralization and priming effect occurred earlier with increasing soil salinity.
